input.command: python3 -c 'import duckdb; p="./data/crashes.parquet"; q="""WITH b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) >= 20 OR EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) < 6 THEN '\''Night (8pm–5:59am)'\'' ELSE '\''Day (6am–7:59pm)'\'' END period, COALESCE(number_of_persons_injured,0) injured, COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed,0) killed FROM read_parquet(?)), s AS (SELECT period, COUNT(*) crashes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE injured > 0 OR killed > 0) casualty_crashes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE killed > 0) fatal_crashes, SUM(injured) injured_people, SUM(killed) killed_people FROM b GROUP BY period) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0*casualty_crashes/crashes,3) casualty_crash_pct, ROUND(1000.0*fatal_crashes/crashes,3) fatal_crashes_per_1000, ROUND(100.0*(injured_people+killed_people)/crashes,3) casualties_per_100_crashes FROM s ORDER BY CASE WHEN period LIKE '\''Night%'\'' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END"""; print(duckdb.connect().execute(q,[p]).fetchdf().to_string(index=False)); print(duckdb.connect().execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_persons_injured IS NULL) ni, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_persons_killed IS NULL) nk, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_time IS NULL) nt FROM read_parquet(?)",[p]).fetchdf().to_string(index=False))'

python3 -c 'import os, duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True); p="./data/crashes.parquet"; q="""WITH base AS (SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) >= 20 OR EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) < 6 THEN '''Night (8pm–5:59am)''' ELSE '''Day (6am–7:59pm)''' END period, number_of_persons_injured injured, number_of_persons_killed killed FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date < DATE '''2026-01-01''' AND number_of_persons_injured IS NOT NULL AND number_of_persons_killed IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT period, COUNT(*) crashes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE injured > 0 OR killed > 0) casualty_crashes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE killed > 0) fatal_crashes, SUM(injured) injured_people, SUM(killed) killed_people FROM base GROUP BY period) SELECT *, 100.0*casualty_crashes/crashes casualty_crash_pct, 1000.0*fatal_crashes/crashes fatal_crashes_per_1000, 100.0*(injured_people+killed_people)/crashes casualties_per_100_crashes FROM s ORDER BY CASE WHEN period LIKE '''Night%''' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END"""; df=duckdb.connect().execute(q,[p]).fetchdf(); print(df.to_string(index=False)); metrics=[("casualty_crash_pct","Share of crashes with at least one person injured or killed","Percent of crashes","share of crashes (%)","Any injury or death per crash"),("fatal_crashes_per_1000","Fatal crashes per 1,000 recorded crashes","Fatal crashes per 1,000 crashes","fatal crashes per 1,000","Fatal crash rate per crash"),("casualties_per_100_crashes","Injured and killed people per 100 recorded crashes","People injured or killed per 100 crashes","people per 100 crashes","Casualty burden per crash")]; colors=["#17324D","#D58B32"]; order=["Night (8pm–5:59am)","Day (6am–7:59pm)"]; df=df.set_index("period").loc[order].reset_index(); note="2012–2025; night 8pm–5:59am, day 6am–7:59pm. Per-crash measures; no traffic/exposure denominator."; exec("for i,(col,title,ylabel,csvname,short) in enumerate(metrics,1):
    numcol={1:"casualty_crashes",2:"fatal_crashes",3:None}[i]
    rows=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        value=r[col]
        numerator=r[numcol] if numcol else r["injured_people"]+r["killed_people"]
        denominator=r["crashes"]
        rows.append({"period":r["period"],"numerator":int(numerator),"denominator_crashes":int(denominator),"metric_value":float(value),"metric":short})
    vals=pd.DataFrame(rows); vals.to_csv(f"./out/values_{i}.csv",index=False)
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5.4)); bars=ax.bar(["Night\n8pm–5:59am","Day\n6am–7:59pm"],vals.metric_value,color=colors,width=.58)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel); ax.set_title(title,fontsize=15,weight="bold",pad=14); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for b,v in zip(bars,vals.metric_value): ax.annotate(f"{v:.2f}",(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,b.get_height()),xytext=(0,6),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=11,weight="bold")
    ax.text(.5,-.22,note,transform=ax.transAxes,ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#444",wrap=True); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"./out/option_{i}.png",dpi=170,bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)
print("Saved three charts and values files.")")'
